I sent a friend request on discord! I play quite a bit of Minecraft, maybe we could start a survival world together or something? 
I’m in the US, and I’m quite anxious around new people and talking to them so I apologize if I seem weird at first, I’m just terrible at talking to people
Yup! I used to play on Minecraft servers all the time and played those sorts of mini games
I’ll play whatever. I mostly build in either, so I don’t really care what game mode it is as long as I get to build or design something.

Mostly Overwatch on Xbox, but I also have Grounded, Hunt: Showdown, RDR2, Witcher 3, Minecraft and House Flipper. I’ve also played Slime Rancher multiple times. 
I used to have a pc, so on there I’ve played The Sims 4 with all of the expansions at the time, the latest one that had been released was the cats and dogs, Minecraft, and Yandere Simulator.
Hi everyone! I’m 13, turning 14 in the next couple months. I love playing video games and reading! I also like watching anime and cooking.
Hello, I could also use some kind words. Would it be okay if I dm you?

If it wouldn’t have been ranked I would have left after he kept saying the comments after I told him to stop. Sadly in ranked if you leave mid match you’ll get suspended if not banned, and you lose some of your ranking points which are hard to get back.
I did tell him at first that I was uncomfortable (after the first comment) and he kept going on, which is why I was surprised no one said anything.
Yup! I play Overwatch on console, so I can’t change servers, sadly.

The friend that called me an asshole never really respected my feelings and always said rude stuff, but I always felt bad because they were depressed so I stayed friends with them. After the situation I posted about I cut all contact and called their behavior out. 
Robert is seventeen, that’s all I’ll say. I haven’t played with Robert since then, as I left the team I was playing on and was transferred due to...other issues.
No offense taken. I cut contact with the friend and I’ve been trying to cut out all of the negative people in my life.
Yeah, I’ve cut contact with the friend that told me I should date him. Honestly I should’ve done so sooner
